Perks › Rare

Table Thief

Rare perk · Active ability

Once per round, choose one of your bones and one face-down opponent bone to swap blindly.

In-game card text

How it works

On your turn, choose one of your bones and one of Rival's face-down bones, and they trade places. You pick Rival's bone blind.

  • After the trade both bones are public: you can see what you received and Rival can see what you gave away.
  • Each copy gives one swap per hand. Using it does not end your turn.
  • Turncoat is the legendary version that shows you Rival's whole rack first.

At a glance

RarityRare
TypeActive ability
UsesOne use per hand for each copy you hold. Uses refill at the start of every hand.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 600 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Uncommon perks.
